mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review(mno, title, content, rating, image_name) VALUES(#{mno}, #{title}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{imageName})
mapper.select: SELECT r.rno, r.mno, r.title, r.content, r.rating, r.image_name, r.created_at , m.mno AS writer_mno, m.email, m.name FROM review r JOIN member m ON r.mno = m.mno WHERE r.rno = #{rno}
